chunks: Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام was asked about the doubtful day.
He said: “That I fast one day from Shaʿban is more beloved to me than that I break the fast for one day from the month of Ramadan.”

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, a title of Imam ʿAli عليه السلام
key_terms.أُفْطِرَ: that I break the fast or refrain from fasting
key_terms.الْيَوْمِ الْمَشْكُوكِ: the doubtful day, when it is uncertain whether it is Shaʿban or Ramadan

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali عليه السلام say about fasting on the day of doubt between Shaʿban and Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling-related caution concerning the day of doubt, when it is uncertain whether the date belongs to Shaʿban or Ramadan. Imam ʿAli عليه السلام expresses preference for fasting it as a day of Shaʿban rather than risking omission of a day from Ramadan, highlighting carefulness in the matter of sawm.
